name: Permanent Residence for Five Years, Family Reunion (Spouse/Dependent Relative of a Slovak Citizen)

requirement_groups.name: Spouse of a Slovak citizen holding permanent residence

requirements.blocker_text: Valid marriage to a Slovak citizen who holds permanent residence in Slovakia; marriages celebrated abroad require a Slovak marriage certificate from the Special Registry Office in Bratislava.

requirement_groups.name: Dependent direct-line relative or child of a Slovak citizen

requirements.blocker_text: A dependent direct-line relative (e.g. parent) of a Slovak citizen, a child under 18, or a dependent adult child unable to care for themselves due to health conditions.

evidence_required.document: Authenticated marriage certificate (Slovak Special Registry Office certificate if married abroad)
Proof of the Slovak citizen sponsor's permanent residence

outcome.duration_length: 5 years; status may be cancelled if spouses do not maintain a joint family life or the marriage ends before 5 years
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: must maintain a genuine joint family life with the sponsoring spouse for the marriage to remain a valid basis for status

sources.title: IOM Migration Information Centre Slovakia -- permanent residence for 5 years, family-reunion grounds: spouse of a Slovak citizen with permanent residence, dependent direct-line relatives, children under 18, dependent adult children; marriages of convenience grounds for rejection; status cancellable if joint family life ends or marriage terminates before 5 years

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Slovakia). STATUS: DRAFT -- both hard requirements cite the tier-2 IOM page only; Slovakia's own Ministry of Interior/Foreign Police pages were not reachable to sufficient tier-1 depth in this pass. NOTABLE STRUCTURAL FEATURE: unlike most other countries in this dataset, family of a SLOVAK CITIZEN goes straight into the 5-year PERMANENT residence track (not a lower temporary-residence tier first) -- an unusually generous starting point. This file does NOT cover family reunification for relatives of a THIRD-COUNTRY-NATIONAL resident (as opposed to a Slovak citizen) -- Slovakia appears to run a separate, lower 'temporary residence for family reunification' track for that population (referenced in search results via akmv.sk and euraxess.sk but not independently fetched in this pass) -- disclosed as a scope limitation rather than modeled. pr_after_months (48) reflects the 'held the 5-year permit for at least 4 years' threshold to reach unlimited permanent residence (see sk_permanent_residence.json).
